import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_2.csv"
source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_3.csv"

Source3_62_0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
Source3_62_1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
Source3_62_2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)
Source3_62_3 = pd.read_csv(source3_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN [["Source3_62_0","Source3_62_2"],["Wrestler","Wrestler"]]
# Join Source3_62_0 and Source3_62_2 on Wrestler, suffix columns to distinguish years 2013 and 2014
join_0_2 = pd.merge(
    Source3_62_0.add_suffix('_2013').rename(columns={'Wrestler_2013': 'Wrestler'}),
    Source3_62_2.add_suffix('_2014').rename(columns={'Wrestler_2014': 'Wrestler'}),
    on='Wrestler',
    how='outer'
)

# Operation 2: UNION ['Source3_62_1', 'Source3_62_3']
# Both have same schema, so union (concat) them
union_1_3 = pd.concat([Source3_62_1, Source3_62_3], ignore_index=True)

# Operation 3: group_by = [Source3_62_0.Wrestler], aggregations = [sum(Wins), sum(Losses), sum(Draws)]
# Group Source3_62_0 by Wrestler and sum Wins, Losses, Draws
grouped_0 = Source3_62_0.groupby('Wrestler', as_index=False).agg({
    'Wins': 'sum',
    'Losses': 'sum',
    'Draws': 'sum'
})

# Operation 4: JOIN [["Source3_62_1","Source3_62_3"],["Wrestler","Wrestler"]]
# Join Source3_62_1 and Source3_62_3 on Wrestler, suffix columns to distinguish years 2015 and 2016
join_1_3 = pd.merge(
    Source3_62_1.add_suffix('_2015').rename(columns={'Wrestler_2015': 'Wrestler'}),
    Source3_62_3.add_suffix('_2016').rename(columns={'Wrestler_2016': 'Wrestler'}),
    on='Wrestler',
    how='outer'
)

# Operation 5: JOIN [["JOIN : [\"Source3_62_0\",\"Source3_62_1\"]", ["Wrestler","Wrestler"]]]
# This means join Source3_62_0 and Source3_62_1 on Wrestler
join_0_1 = pd.merge(
    Source3_62_0.add_suffix('_2013').rename(columns={'Wrestler_2013': 'Wrestler'}),
    Source3_62_1.add_suffix('_2014').rename(columns={'Wrestler_2014': 'Wrestler'}),
    on='Wrestler',
    how='outer'
)

# Operation 6: JOIN [["JOIN : [\"JOIN : [\\\"Source3_62_0\\\",\\\"Source3_62_2\\\"]\", \"Source3_62_1\"]", ["Wrestler", "Wrestler"]]]

# From the operations and source data, the years correspond to:

# 2015: Source3_62_1
# 2016: Source3_62_3

# Fill NaN with 0 for numeric columns (Wins, Losses, Draws)
for col in ['2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',

# Reorder columns to match target schema

                     '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',

# Save the final dataframe to the target path

final_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Rename columns in each source to reflect the year corresponding to each source
# According to the target schema, each source corresponds to a year:
# Source3_62_0 -> 2013
# Source3_62_1 -> 2014
# Source3_62_2 -> 2015
# Source3_62_3 -> 2016

df0 = df0.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws': '2013 Draws'
})

df1 = df1.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws': '2014 Draws'
})

df2 = df2.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2015 Wins',
    'Losses': '2015 Losses',
    'Draws': '2015 Draws'
})

df3 = df3.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2016 Wins',
    'Losses': '2016 Losses',
    'Draws': '2016 Draws'
})

# Join all four dataframes on 'Wrestler' using inner joins
# This matches the target schema where each wrestler has stats for all four years
df01 = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='Wrestler', how='inner')
df012 = pd.merge(df01, df2, on='Wrestler', how='inner')
df_all = pd.merge(df012, df3, on='Wrestler', how='inner')

# Group by Wrestler and sum all numeric columns to ensure uniqueness and aggregation
# This is needed because some wrestlers may appear multiple times in source tables
group_cols = ['Wrestler']
agg_cols = [col for col in df_all.columns if col != 'Wrestler']

df_final = df_all.groupby(group_cols, as_index=False)[agg_cols].sum()

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file with exact column names as target schema
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
